en: The image depicts a quaint European village at the base of a wooded hill or small mountain. In the foreground is a country road with a person and a dog. The village has characteristic steep-roofed houses and a church with a tall spire. At the top of the hill stands a round tower, possibly a castle or lookout, flying a flag. Most of the scene is rendered in black and white sketch or engraving style. There is no visible text on the image.
